description: Paginate or columnate FILE(s) for printing.

option.name: --across
tip: print columns across rather than down, used together with -COLUMN

option.name: --columns
tip: output COLUMN columns and print columns down, unless -a is used. Balance number of lines in the columns on each page

option.name: --date-format
tip: use FORMAT for the header date

option.name: --double-space
tip: double space the output

option.name: --expand-tabs
tip: expand input CHARs (TABs) to tab WIDTH (8)

option.name: --first-line-number
tip: start counting with NUMBER at 1st line of first page printed (see +FIRST_PAGE)

option.name: --form-feed
tip: use form feeds instead of newlines to separate pages (by a 3-line page header with -F or a 5-line header and trailer without -F)

option.name: --header
tip: use a centered HEADER instead of filename in page header, -h "" prints a blank line, don't use -h""

option.name: --indent
tip: offset each line with MARGIN (zero) spaces, do not affect -w or -W, MARGIN will be added to PAGE_WIDTH

option.name: --join-lines
tip: merge full lines, turns off -W line truncation, no column alignment, --sep-string[=STRING] sets separators

option.name: --length
tip: set the page length to PAGE_LENGTH (66) lines (default number of lines of text 56, and with -F 63). implies -t if PAGE_LENGTH <= 10

option.name: --merge
tip: print all files in parallel, one in each column, truncate lines, but join lines of full length with -J

option.name: --no-file-warnings
tip: omit warning when a file cannot be opened

option.name: --number-lines
tip: number lines, use DIGITS (5) digits, then SEP (TAB), default counting starts with 1st line of input file

option.name: --omit-header
tip: omit page headers and trailers; implied if PAGE_LENGTH <= 10

option.name: --omit-pagination
tip: omit page headers and trailers, eliminate any pagination by form feeds set in input files

option.name: --output-tabs
tip: replace spaces with CHARs (TABs) to tab WIDTH (8)

option.name: --page-width
tip: set page width to PAGE_WIDTH (72) characters always, truncate lines, except -J option is set, no interference with -S or -s

option.name: --pages
tip: begin [stop] printing with page FIRST_[LAST_]PAGE

option.name: --sep-string
tip: separate columns by STRING, without -S: Default separator <TAB> with -J and <space> otherwise (same as -S" "), no effect on column options

option.name: --separator
tip: separate columns by a single character, default for CHAR is the <TAB> character without -w and 'no char' with -w. -s[CHAR] turns off line truncation of all 3 column options (-COLUMN|-a -COLUMN|-m) except -w is set

option.name: --show-control-chars
tip: use hat notation (^G) and octal backslash notation

option.name: --show-nonprinting
tip: use octal backslash notation

option.name: --width
tip: set page width to PAGE_WIDTH (72) characters for multiple text-column output only, -s[char] turns off (72)

global_option.name: --help
tip: display this help and exit

global_option.name: --version
tip: output version information and exit
